The ear boundary softness is likely a combination of depth-of-field blur and minor generation smoothing. The topology mask confirms the subject is a single coherent entity, ruling out floating parts, but does not resolve the internal limb structure issues.

The pose is natural, but the anatomical detail is lacking.
